title: ‘छोरी ब्रह्माण्ड’का कथामा मानव–रोबोट सम्बन्ध {The human-robot relationship in the story of 'Daughter Universe'}

american_english: In this article, the human–robot relationship expressed in the stories of Sarubhakta's science fiction collection Chhori Brahmanda is analyzed. This article is focused on resolving the academic problem regarding what the human–robot relationship is like in the stories of the Chhori Brahmanda collection. For this purpose, primary and secondary materials have been collected through library work, and taking as a theoretical basis the tenets concerning robots presented by Isaac Asimov in Robot Visions (1990), an analytical framework based on three main aspects—(a) endangered human labor, (b) desire for offspring and robots, and (c) human biological limitations and robots—has been utilized. From the analysis of the human–robot relationship expressed in the stories of this collection, the conclusion is presented that alongside the positive possibilities of robot usage in future society, these stories also caution against the risks they may entail.
